recommended_study.context: One deterministic whole-source-unit packing policy shared across arms. Exact premise/hypothesis token pair length <=512 including special tokens. Never silently truncate the claim, reinterpret missing evidence as NotMentioned, or change packing after outcomes.
recommended_study.dev: Root must freeze new public label-blind document groups, disjoint all past exposed AND reserved/held confirmation groups; exact identities/source/scorer and role hashes before measurement. Do not reuse old12 as fresh.
recommended_study.gates: Freeze accuracy-gain, each-class coverage, Brier/NLL nonincrease, complete arm counts, p50/p95, errors, CPU/memory and600s physical-close gates before execution. No promotion from DEV alone.
recommended_study.numeric_checks: Before measurement freeze numerical/date/entity/source-offset checks; diagnostics may flag disagreement but may not invent a confidence override. NLI reading alone is not a numerical proof.
